subject: Post-demo: Performance & SLO recap + MAP next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Performance & SLO recap + MAP next steps

Hi Mike / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — appreciate the time. As promised, here’s a concise recap of the performance / SLO items we talked through and the proposed next steps (MAP = mutual action plan).

SLO checklist (high level):
- Latency: p95 end-to-end token latency target <= 150 ms for 512-token requests (gen endpoints). First-byte latency goal for streaming clients: <= 120 ms.
- Throughput: steady-state throughput target ~1200 tokens/sec across the service footprint; burstable to ~2500 tokens/sec for short windows.
- Concurrency: expected concurrent active sessions ~200–300 (concurrent model inference connections), with average QPS per session ~0.2.
- Streaming: client requires partial token streaming (SSE or chunked) for user-facing chat. We validated our runtime supports streaming with KV cache preservation across continued conversation.
- Availability: 99.9% monthly SLA target (we discussed Dedicated capacity if you need stronger latency guarantees).

Attachments: redwood-slo-checklist.xlsx (attached) — includes estimated capacity and a few example load profiles. Demo recording link attached as well.

Open questions we noted:
1) Do you have a hard p95 latency threshold that would be a deal breaker?
2) Any specific encryption/KMS or VPC requirements we should surface to the infra team before a pilot?

Proposed next steps:
- Share technical MAP doc (link below) and run a short tech deep-dive (30–45m) with your infra/eng team — propose Wed 2026-09-01 10:00 AM PT.
- Redwood to produce a Dedicated capacity estimate based on the attached profiles (Aditya will take this on).
- If the MAP looks good, discuss a 2-week pilot scoped to your user-concurrency profile.

Links: https://drive.google.com/fintechco/FT-4821-MAP

Thanks — I’ll loop Aditya and Rishi for the capacity estimate.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0147

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Streaming: we prefer SSE for web clients; can you confirm partial response chunking supports SSE and reconnections mid-conversation without losing context?
- Concurrency: the 200–300 concurrent sessions number is correct; peak spikes may go to ~450 for short marketing events. Do you have recommendations for capacity headroom?
- Security: we'll need basic KMS integration and an initial SOC2 evidence pack — is that something we can pull during the pilot?

If you can confirm the streaming behavior and provide a rough Dedicated estimate, we can lock the tech deep-dive. Wed 9/1 10 AM PT works for Daniel and me.

—
Mike Johnson
Director of Engineering, FintechCo
mike.johnson@fintechco.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Performance & SLO recap + MAP next steps

Hi Mike / Daniel —

Quick answers inline: 

> can you confirm partial response chunking supports SSE and reconnections mid-conversation without losing context?
Yes — our streaming pathway supports SSE and chunked HTTP streaming. For reconnections we persist the KV cache on the server side for the session id; reconnection within the session TTL will resume without needing a full regen. We’ll surface the session TTL and reconnection guarantees in the MAP doc.

> peak spikes may go to ~450 — recommendations for capacity headroom?
For that profile we recommend Dedicated with a 1.5x safety buffer for peaks, and an autoscaling burst policy for short windows. I asked Aditya to draft an initial capacity estimate using the attached load profiles.

> KMS / SOC2 evidence during pilot?
Yes — we can provide SOC2 evidence and KMS integration details during the pilot. Rishi will coordinate the security artifacts.

Next steps (updated):
- Aditya: deliver Dedicated capacity estimate and an initial cost run for the pilot (target 2 business days).
- Rishi: share SOC2 evidence pack + KMS integration checklist ahead of the deep-dive.
- Schedule: wed 2026-09-01 10:00 AM PT — confirmed. Calendar invite to follow.

If anything else comes up before the deep-dive, flag it here and we’ll prep answers in the tech meeting. Looking forward to it.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
